title: Warm Pillowy Dutch Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Dutch dish featuring chicken cooked in a rich tagine sauce with soy sauce, perfect for a post-workout meal, and diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, tagine spice mix, chicken broth, and dried apricots, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
